validation.interpretation: Equal tasks after within-task condition means. Empty recognition set has accuracy/specificity only and is excluded from balanced ranking. Fixed argmax, no calibration.

architecture: Full scratch control except the learned Conv([R_old,H]) comparator is absent and C is merged attention-head context before W_O. U=W_O(C) and the terminal spatial priority readout are unchanged.

construction_checks.cross_platform_checkpoint_comparison: Exact equality required remotely under the control runtime; local Windows construction may differ from the Linux checkpoint.

lineage.comparator: C_t is concat_heads(sum_j A_t,h,i,j V_t,h,j) before W_O; the learned Conv([R_t-1,H_t]) comparator is absent.
